generatedFrom.method: Each of the 20 invariants asserted in docs/stitch/phase-13a-final-acceptance.md §3 was re-checked against the tree: does an implementation exist, and does an executable test exercise it? `automated` is true ONLY when a test file runs assertions against the shipped code path.

gradingKey.automated: An executable test imports and exercises the shipped implementation.
gradingKey.self-contained: A test asserts the RULE but re-declares the logic inside the test file; the shipped code path is never imported, so the test cannot fail if production drifts.
gradingKey.implemented-untested: The behaviour exists in source but no test covers it.
gradingKey.not-locatable: The enforcement mechanism named in Phase 13A §3 does not resolve to a file in this repository.

The domainInvariants.test.ts copy (line 106) is self-contained and redundant.

correctionToPhase13A: docs/stitch/phase-13a-final-acceptance.md §3 marks all 20 '✅ Automated'. On this SHA, 9 are automated against shipped code, 5 are self-contained restatements inside the test file, 3 name services that do not resolve to any path in this repository, and 3 are implemented but wholly untested. The suite passes (531/531) because a self-contained test asserts its own fixtures — passing it proves the rule was written down, not that the product obeys it.
